text:
The main ingredients in bread are flour, water, yeast, and salt.

Elias stood in the dim light of the bakery, his hands dusted white with flour, mirroring the stillness of Clara in the attic. He watched the dough rise, a slow, silent breathing that reminded him of the days before the silence fell over his own home. "Flour," he whispered to the empty room, "is the earth. Water is the memory. Yeast is the hope that refuses to die. And salt... salt is the grief that gives it flavor." He kneaded the mixture, feeling the resistance, the warmth, the life within it, just as Clara had felt the weight of her father's hat.
